opening.argument: The central message is a warning against Cloud Token, not an invitation to participate. The creator opens by questioning a cryptocurrency wallet that promises monthly interest, then calls the offering a Ponzi scam. He examines the claimed trading mechanism and points to a lack of proof that the trading occurs. He also describes an investment requirement tied to recruitment commissions, making the referral structure part of his criticism. These are presented as reasons for caution, not as benefits for viewers to pursue. His closing advice is explicit: people tempted to invest should be steered away. Nothing in that warning asks viewers to invest, send money, or provide personal data.

citations.quote: A cryptocurrency wallet on your iPhone that pays you monthly interest has to be too good to be true.
